verdict.rationale: Serving models to other devices is a fair question for a local-inference SDK and CLI, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows RunAnywhere exposing a local model as a server reachable over the LAN. The only OpenAI-compatible endpoint documented is the hosted Wally Cloud API, and the local CLI docs describe running a model on the same machine, not serving it to other devices.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can serve models over my local network for access from other devices
